Emīls Latkovskis | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Aleksandre Rekhviashvili]] | league = [[Latvian Higher League]] | season = [[2025 Latvian First League|2025]] | position = [[Latvian First League]], 1st (promoted) | website = https://ogreunited.lv/ | current = 2026 Latvian Higher League | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _mariupol1819h | pattern_ra1 = | leftarm1 = 000055 | body1 = 000055 | rightarm1 = 000055 | shorts1 = 000055 | socks1 = 000055 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _molde17a | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Ogre United''' is a Latvian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ogre, Latvia|Ogre]], competing in the [[Latvian Higher League]], the highest tier of Latvian football. The club was founded in 2022 and began playing in the [[Latvian Third League]]. Ogre United won the North region and reached the regional final — losing to JDFS Alberts' reserve team — which secured their promotion to the [[Latvian Second League]].{{Cite web |title=Latvijas 3. līga 2022 – Ogre United results |url=https://www.flashscore.com/team/ogre-united/ |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=Flashscore |language=en}}{{Dead link|date=June 2026}}{{Cite web |title=Latvijas 3. līga: Ogre United ceļš līdz sudrabam |url=https://sportacentrs.com/futbols/latvija/ogre_united_3_liga |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=Sportacentrs.com |language=lv}} In the 2023 season, the club won the Eastern zone and finished second in the promotion group, securing promotion to the [[Future League|Latvian First League]]. In their debut season, the team finished 11th.{{Cite web |title=Latvian First League 2024 standings |url=https://www.besoccer.com/competition/table/latvia_first_league/2024 |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=BeSoccer |language=en}} In 2025, Ogre United won the First League and earned promotion to the Higher League for the first time in their history.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-08 |title=Sagaidot vajadzīgo iznākumu no sāncenšiem, par Nākotnes līgas čempioni kļūst "Ogre United" |url=https://sportacentrs.com/futbols/1_liga/08112025-sagaidot_vajadzigo_konkurentu_rezultatu_p |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=Sportacentrs.com |language=lv}}{{Cite web |date=2025-11-10 |title=Ogre United’s rise to the top: first title and promotion |url=https://balticfootballnews.com/ogre-uniteds-rise-to-the-top-first-title-first-promotion-and-new-challenges-ahead/ |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=Baltic Football News |language=en}}{{cite web | title="Mettai" pēc 14 gadiem jāpamet virslīga, vietā nāks Ogre | newspaper=[[Latvijas Avīze]] | url=https://www.lasi.lv/par-svarigo/sports/mettai-pec-14-gadiem-japamet-virsliga-vieta-naks-ogre.34386 |location=Riga| language=lv | access-date=4 January 2026|first=Ilmārs |last=Stūriška|trans-title=Metta must leave the Premier League after 14 years, Ogre will take its place|date=11 November 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251119050648/https://www.lasi.lv/par-svarigo/sports/mettai-pec-14-gadiem-japamet-virsliga-vieta-naks-ogre.34386|archive-date=19 November 2025}}"}}
